  export interface PathResult { nodes: string[]; dirs: EdgeDir[] }
  export function findPath(idx: GraphIndex, fromId: string, toId: string): PathResult | null {
    if (!idx.personById.has(fromId) || !idx.personById.has(toId)) return null;
    if (fromId === toId) return { nodes: [fromId], dirs: [] };
    const prev = new Map<string, { node: string; dir: EdgeDir }>();
    const visited = new Set<string>([fromId]);
    const queue: string[] = [fromId];
    for (let qi = 0; qi < queue.length; qi++) {
      const cur = queue[qi]!;
      for (const edge of idx.adj.get(cur) ?? []) {
        if (visited.has(edge.to)) continue;
        visited.add(edge.to);
        prev.set(edge.to, { node: cur, dir: edge.dir });
        if (edge.to === toId) {
          // reconstruct
          const nodes = [toId]; const dirs: EdgeDir[] = [];
          let cursor = toId;
          while (cursor !== fromId) {
            const step = prev.get(cursor)!;
            nodes.unshift(step.node); dirs.unshift(step.dir); cursor = step.node;
          }
          return { nodes, dirs };
        }
        queue.push(edge.to);
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

/**
 * Family-graph primitives for the kinship engine.
 *
 * Input shape (plain JSON, D1/Workers friendly, zero dependencies):
 *   persons  : [{ id, gender, dob, birth_order }]
 *   couples  : [{ couple_id, partner_a, partner_b }]
 *   child_of : [{ couple_id, child_person_id }]
 *
 * Derived relations:
 *   parents(P)       = the two partners of any couple C with child_of(C, P)
 *   children(P)      = children listed under any couple where P is a partner
 *   spouse(P)        = the other partner of any couple containing P
 *   fullSiblings(P)  = other children of the same parent-couple
 *
 * Edges are traversed undirected with labels:
 *   up   -> to a parent
 *   sp   -> to a spouse
 *   down -> to a child
 */

export interface KinshipPerson {
  id: string;
  /** "m" or "f" recommended; anything else is treated as unknown. */
  gender?: string;
  /** ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD preferred). Empty or undefined = unknown. */
  dob?: string;
  /** 1 = first-born. Used as fallback for age comparison when dob is missing. */
  birth_order?: number;
}

export interface KinshipCouple {
  couple_id: string;
  partner_a: string;
  partner_b: string;
}

export interface ChildOfLink {
  couple_id: string;
  child_person_id: string;
}

export interface FamilyGraph {
  persons: KinshipPerson[];
  couples: KinshipCouple[];
  child_of: ChildOfLink[];
}

/** Labelled undirected edge kinds used by the BFS. */
export type EdgeDir = "up" | "sp" | "down";

export interface Neighbor {
  dir: EdgeDir;
  to: string;
}

export interface GraphIndex {
  personById: Map<string, KinshipPerson>;
  /**
   * Adjacency lists, pre-sorted into the deterministic tie-break order
   * up < sp < down (insertion order preserved within one kind).
   */
  adj: Map<string, Neighbor[]>;
}

export interface PathResult {
  /** Person ids from `fromId` to `toId` inclusive. */
  nodes: string[];
  /** Edge labels; dirs.length === nodes.length - 1. */
  dirs: EdgeDir[];
}

const DIR_RANK: Record<EdgeDir, number> = { up: 0, sp: 1, down: 2 };

function pushInto<K, V>(map: Map<K, V[]>, key: K, value: V): void {
  const list = map.get(key);
  if (list) list.push(value);
  else map.set(key, [value]);
}

/** Normalize a gender string to "m" | "f"; null when unknown. */
export function normGender(raw?: string): "m" | "f" | null {
  const c = (raw ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
  if (c.startsWith("m")) return "m";
  if (c.startsWith("f")) return "f";
  return null;
}

/** Index the graph once; adjacency lists are built and sorted here. */
export function buildIndex(graph: FamilyGraph): GraphIndex {
  const personById = new Map<string, KinshipPerson>();
  for (const p of graph.persons) personById.set(p.id, p);

  const coupleById = new Map<string, KinshipCouple>();
  for (const c of graph.couples) coupleById.set(c.couple_id, c);

  const couplesOfPartner = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const c of graph.couples) {
    pushInto(couplesOfPartner, c.partner_a, c.couple_id);
    if (c.partner_b !== c.partner_a) pushInto(couplesOfPartner, c.partner_b, c.couple_id);
  }

  const parentCouplesOf = new Map<string, string[]>();
  const childrenOf = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const link of graph.child_of) {
    if (!coupleById.has(link.couple_id)) continue;
    pushInto(parentCouplesOf, link.child_person_id, link.couple_id);
    pushInto(childrenOf, link.couple_id, link.child_person_id);
  }

  const adj = new Map<string, Neighbor[]>();
  const listFor = (id: string): Neighbor[] => {
    const existing = adj.get(id);
    if (existing) return existing;
    const fresh: Neighbor[] = [];
    adj.set(id, fresh);
    return fresh;
  };
  for (const id of personById.keys()) listFor(id);

  const addEdge = (from: string, dir: EdgeDir, to: string): void => {
    if (to === from) return; // ignore degenerate self-loops
    const list = listFor(from);
    if (!list.some((n) => n.dir === dir && n.to === to)) list.push({ dir, to });
  };

  for (const [child, coupleIds] of parentCouplesOf) {
    for (const cid of coupleIds) {
      const couple = coupleById.get(cid);
      if (!couple) continue;
      addEdge(child, "up", couple.partner_a);
      addEdge(child, "up", couple.partner_b);
    }
  }
  for (const [partner, coupleIds] of couplesOfPartner) {
    for (const cid of coupleIds) {
      const couple = coupleById.get(cid);
      if (!couple) continue;
      const other = couple.partner_a === partner ? couple.partner_b : couple.partner_a;
      addEdge(partner, "sp", other);
      for (const child of childrenOf.get(cid) ?? []) addEdge(partner, "down", child);
    }
  }

  for (const list of adj.values()) {
    list.sort((a, b) => DIR_RANK[a.dir] - DIR_RANK[b.dir]); // Array#sort is stable
  }

  return { personById, adj };
}

/**
 * BFS from fromId to toId over labelled undirected edges.
 * Shortest path wins; ties resolved deterministically by the
 * up < sp < down neighbour order (FIFO queue + pre-sorted lists).
 * Returns null when the two ids are unknown or disconnected.
 */
export function findPath(idx: GraphIndex, fromId: string, toId: string): PathResult | null {
  if (!idx.personById.has(fromId) || !idx.personById.has(toId)) return null;
  if (fromId === toId) return { nodes: [fromId], dirs: [] };

  const visited = new Set<string>([fromId]);
  const prev = new Map<string, { node: string; dir: EdgeDir }>();
  const queue: string[] = [fromId];

  for (let head = 0; head < queue.length; head++) {
    const cur = queue[head];
    if (cur === undefined) break;
    for (const edge of idx.adj.get(cur) ?? []) {
      if (visited.has(edge.to)) continue;
      visited.add(edge.to);
      prev.set(edge.to, { node: cur, dir: edge.dir });
      if (edge.to === toId) {
        const nodes: string[] = [toId];
        const dirs: EdgeDir[] = [];
        let cursor = toId;
        while (cursor !== fromId) {
          const step = prev.get(cursor);
          if (!step) break; // unreachable by construction
          nodes.unshift(step.node);
          dirs.unshift(step.dir);
          cursor = step.node;
        }
        return { nodes, dirs };
      }
      queue.push(edge.to);
    }
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * Relation classifier: turns the BFS edge sequence into a canonical
 * relation key from the REQUIRED KEYS vocabulary (plus son_sp/da_sp,
 * which carry authoritative term rows).
 *
 * Shapes without a defined key (stepparents, spouse's siblings,
 * great-grandparents and deeper, ...) yield relation_key = null while
 * still returning the path that was found.
 *
 * Elder/younger (_el/_yo): decided by dob compare (ISO dates), falling
 * back to birth_order (lower = born earlier = elder). When neither is
 * comparable we DEFAULT TO _yo — a deliberate choice so every ambiguous
 * pair lands on one predictable key. For parental siblings the age
 * compare runs between THEM and the LINKING parent (never ego).
 */
import {
  buildIndex,
  findPath,
  normGender,
  type EdgeDir,
  type FamilyGraph,
  type GraphIndex,
  type KinshipPerson,
} from "./graph";

export interface Classification {
  relation_key: string | null;
  /** Person ids from fromId to toId inclusive ([] when no path exists). */
  path: string[];
}

/** Indexed graphs are cached per snapshot; treat graphs as immutable. */
const indexCache = new WeakMap<FamilyGraph, GraphIndex>();

function indexFor(graph: FamilyGraph): GraphIndex {
  const hit = indexCache.get(graph);
  if (hit) return hit;
  const fresh = buildIndex(graph);
  indexCache.set(graph, fresh);
  return fresh;
}

/** -1 when a is strictly elder, 1 when strictly younger, 0 when unknown. */
function compareAge(a?: KinshipPerson, b?: KinshipPerson): -1 | 0 | 1 {
  const da = Date.parse(a?.dob ?? "");
  const db = Date.parse(b?.dob ?? "");
  if (Number.isFinite(da) && Number.isFinite(db) && da !== db) return da < db ? -1 : 1;
  const oa = a?.birth_order;
  const ob = b?.birth_order;
  if (typeof oa === "number" && typeof ob === "number" && oa !== ob) return oa < ob ? -1 : 1;
  return 0;
}

function ageSuffix(a?: KinshipPerson, b?: KinshipPerson): "el" | "yo" {
  return compareAge(a, b) < 0 ? "el" : "yo"; // default "_yo" when unknown
}

function genderAt(idx: GraphIndex, nodes: string[], i: number): "m" | "f" | null {
  const person = idx.personById.get(nodes[i] ?? "");
  return normGender(person?.gender);
}

function personAt(idx: GraphIndex, nodes: string[], i: number): KinshipPerson | undefined {
  return idx.personById.get(nodes[i] ?? "");
}

/** Map a labelled path to its canonical relation key (null when unmapped). */
export function canonicalKey(idx: GraphIndex, nodes: string[], dirs: EdgeDir[]): string | null {
  const seq = dirs.join(",");

  switch (seq) {
    case "":
      return "self";

    case "up":
      return genderAt(idx, nodes, 1) === "m" ? "fa" : genderAt(idx, nodes, 1) === "f" ? "mo" : null;

    case "sp":
      return "spouse";

    case "down":
      return genderAt(idx, nodes, 1) === "m" ? "son" : genderAt(idx, nodes, 1) === "f" ? "daughter" : null;

    case "up,up": {
      // grandparent; paternal/maternal by the gender of the linking parent
      const side = genderAt(idx, nodes, 1) === "m" ? "pat" : genderAt(idx, nodes, 1) === "f" ? "mat" : null;
      if (!side) return null;
      const tgt = genderAt(idx, nodes, 2);
      if (tgt === "m") return `grandfa_${side}`;
      if (tgt === "f") return `grandmo_${side}`;
      return null;
    }

    case "down,down": {
      const tgt = genderAt(idx, nodes, 2);
      return tgt === "m" ? "grandson" : tgt === "f" ? "granddaughter" : null;
    }

    case "up,down": {
      // sibling (full or half) reached through a shared parent
      const sib = genderAt(idx, nodes, 1);
      if (sib === "m") return `brother_${ageSuffix(personAt(idx, nodes, 1), personAt(idx, nodes, 0))}`;
      if (sib === "f") return `sister_${ageSuffix(personAt(idx, nodes, 1), personAt(idx, nodes, 0))}`;
      return null;
    }

    case "up,up,down": {
      // parent's sibling (the linking parent is nodes[1])
      const link = genderAt(idx, nodes, 1);
      const tgt = genderAt(idx, nodes, 2);
      if (link === "m") {
        if (tgt === "m") return `fa_br_${ageSuffix(personAt(idx, nodes, 2), personAt(idx, nodes, 1))}`;
        if (tgt === "f") return "fa_si";
      } else if (link === "f") {
        if (tgt === "m") return "mo_br";
        if (tgt === "f") return `mo_si_${ageSuffix(personAt(idx, nodes, 2), personAt(idx, nodes, 1))}`;
      }
      return null;
    }

    case "up,down,down": {
      // sibling's child (nodes[1] is the sibling)
      const sib = genderAt(idx, nodes, 1);
      const tgt = genderAt(idx, nodes, 2);
      if (sib === "m") return tgt === "m" ? "brother_son" : tgt === "f" ? "brother_daughter" : null;
      if (sib === "f") return tgt === "m" ? "sister_son" : tgt === "f" ? "sister_daughter" : null;
      return null;
    }

    case "down,sp": {
      // child's spouse
      const child = genderAt(idx, nodes, 1);
      return child === "m" ? "son_sp" : child === "f" ? "da_sp" : null;
    }

    case "up,up,down,down":
      // parent's sibling's child collapses to a single key
      return "cousin";

    case "up,up,down,sp": {
      // parental sibling's spouse (linking parent = nodes[1], sibling = nodes[2])
      const link = genderAt(idx, nodes, 1);
      const rel = genderAt(idx, nodes, 2);
      const tgt = genderAt(idx, nodes, 3);
      if (link === "m" && rel === "m" && tgt === "f")
        return ageSuffix(personAt(idx, nodes, 2), personAt(idx, nodes, 1)) === "el" ? "fa_br_el_sp" : "fa_br_yo_sp";
      if (link === "m" && rel === "f" && tgt === "m") return "fa_si_sp";
      if (link === "f" && rel === "m" && tgt === "f") return "mo_br_sp";
      if (link === "f" && rel === "f" && tgt === "m") return "mo_si_sp";
      return null;
    }

    default:
      return null;
  }
}

/** Public API: classify `toId` relative to `fromId` in the family graph. */
export function classify(graph: FamilyGraph, fromId: string, toId: string): Classification {
  const idx = indexFor(graph);
  const found = findPath(idx, fromId, toId);
  if (!found) return { relation_key: null, path: [] };
  return { relation_key: canonicalKey(idx, found.nodes, found.dirs), path: found.nodes };
}

/**
 * Authoritative kinship vocabulary (verbatim rows from the spec) for
 * en / hi / ta / bn. Stored as a flat table and folded into TERMS.
 *
 * Note: the spec row "bn|ma|ma|mother" carries the canonical key typo'd
 * as "ma"; the canonical key is "mo" (term stays "ma"), so the bn mother
 * row is stored under "mo" to keep resolveTerms("mo") working in bn.
 */

export type Lang = "en" | "hi" | "ta" | "bn";

export interface TermRow {
  term: string;
  gloss: string;
}

type Row = [Lang, string, string, string];

const ROWS: Row[] = [
  // --- en ---
  ["en", "spouse", "spouse", "husband or wife"],
  ...
];

export const TERMS: Record<Lang, Record<string, TermRow>> = { en: {}, hi: {}, ta: {}, bn: {} };
for (const [lang, key, term, gloss] of ROWS) TERMS[lang][key] = { term, gloss };

export interface ResolvedTerms {
  en: TermRow | null;
  hi: TermRow | null;
  ta: TermRow | null;
  bn: TermRow | null;
  /** Canonical English gloss (empty string when unavailable). */
  gloss: string;
}

/**
 * Resolve every language's row for a relation key.
 * Returns null when the key has no authoritative rows at all (e.g. "self").
 */
export function resolveTerms(relationKey: string): ResolvedTerms | null {
  const en = TERMS.en[relationKey];
  if (!en) return null;
  return {
    en: { ...en },
    hi: TERMS.hi[relationKey] ?? null,
    ta: TERMS.ta[relationKey] ?? null,
    bn: TERMS.bn[relationKey] ?? null,
    gloss: en.gloss,
  };
}
